card.name: Linking words before stimulant drug names
card.fires_on: The word "including" (or "such as") right after a stimulant class term like CNS stimulants or amphetamines, just before a specific stimulant drug name is listed.

modes.label: Including after CNS stimulants
modes.description: The word "including" follows "CNS stimulants" or "amphetamines" in abuse and misuse warnings, ahead of a named drug.

modes.label: Such as before appetite suppressants
modes.description: A linking phrase such as "such as" follows a class of anorectic agents before a named drug.
modes.example: the possible presence of pulmonary hypertension. Valvular heart disease associated with the use of some anorectic agents such<< as>> fenfluramine and dexfenfl
